name: MCP Tools
description: Gives AI agents a tool that counts items by tag and one that adds a tag, through Zinc's MCP server.
author: Zinc samples

permission_reasons.library.read: Count items by tag for the tools you offer to AI agents.
permission_reasons.library.write: Add a tag to an item when an AI agent asks.
permission_reasons.mcp.expose: Offer two tools to AI agents connected to Zinc's MCP server. Off until you switch it on in Settings > Plugins.

tools.name: count_tagged
tools.description: Count the library items that carry a tag. Use it to see how many items a tag covers before listing or editing them.

tag.description: The tag, exactly as shown in the tag selector.
